handle_diameter.rule: Must be positive and practical for ergonomic tool use
handle_diameter.reason: Practical grip diameters for hand tools

handle_height.rule: Must be positive and provide adequate grip length above tiles
handle_height.reason: Adequate height for comfortable handle above mounting base

slope_angle.reason: Design intent for ergonomic backward lean

base_hole_diameter_small.reason: Fits compatible attachment points on tulgryd tiles

base_hole_diameter_large.reason: Fits compatible attachment points on tulgryd tiles

base_dimension_vs_diameter.reason: Square base must match handle diameter for proportional appearance and stable mounting

hole_clearance_from_edges.reason: Holes must not intersect or overstress base edges

hole_spacing_minimum.rule: Distance between hole centers >= hole_diameter_small + hole_diameter_large
hole_spacing_minimum.note: If holes are offset rather than concentric

grip_height_independent.reason: Allows custom length-to-diameter ratios for different tool types

mounting_holes.rule: Holes positioned at center of square base
mounting_holes.z: Through base (both holes pierce full base thickness)

hole_pattern.rule: Two holes at same XY center (concentric or stacked)
hole_pattern.note: Both holes positioned for compatible mounting on tulgryd tiles

hole_specifications.hole_clearance: Both holes accommodate tile mounting system

manufacturing_considerations.draft_angles: Not specified - model as designed or add per manufacturing process
manufacturing_considerations.surface_finish: Not specified - standard finish for 3D printing/CNC
manufacturing_considerations.material: Not specified - model is geometry only
